verdict.rationale: Vast.ai gives users direct SSH/file-transfer access to their instances and persistent volumes, and the CLI/API let you script data movement in and out — implying data isn't locked in a proprietary format. However, there is no explicit documentation of a bulk 'export all your data' feature, data-portability guarantee, or account-closure data dump, so this is inferred from infrastructure primitives rather than a stated capability. Missing for 10: an explicit data-export/account-portability policy, documentation of exporting non-instance data (billing history, usage logs, team data), and any statement about leaving without lock-in.
